summary: PRIMARY BUG FIXED — re-verified the HeaderMenu.js pill/CTA overflow bug after the wrapper-centered fix (outer full-width `fixed inset-x-0 flex justify-center px-3 pointer-events-none` + inner `<header pointer-events-auto ... w-full lg:w-auto max-w-full>`). At ALL 9 desktop widths 1024/1050/1100/1150/1200/1250/1280/1440/1920 the Get Started CTA and Log In button are fully inside the frosted pill (overflow_px = -25.00 at every width, i.e., CTA sits 25px INSIDE the pill's right edge). Pill grows to its natural content width (~630.8px at lg / ~654.8px at xl) instead of being capped at 50vw. Pill stays centered (|pill.left - (iw - pill.right)| < 3), no viewport horizontal overflow. Click-through verified: the full-width centering wrapper has `pointer-events: none` and only the pill has `pointer-events: auto`, so hero content behind the wrapper remains clickable (View Pricing click scrolled 0->3670). Mobile responsive (900/768/390) + functionality (nav-pricing, /auth, /auth?mode=login) all PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Optional cleanup: the ghost 401 errors from /api/auth/me on the public landing page still fire 6 times. Non-blocking, but consider gating that call on presence of an auth token to reduce noise (unchanged from iteration_41).

Optional: onLogin uses window.location.href for a full page reload while onCta uses handleGetStarted (SPA nav via React Router). Consider unifying to navigate() for consistency (unchanged from iteration_41).

context_for_next_testing_agent: The wrapper-centered fix (outer full-width `fixed inset-x-0 flex justify-center px-3 pointer-events-none` + inner header with `pointer-events-auto ... w-full lg:w-auto max-w-full`) fully resolves the 50vw containing-block cap. All 9 desktop widths 1024-1920 now show Get Started INSIDE the pill by 25px. Click-through confirmed: wrapper pointer-events:none, header pointer-events:auto; hero content behind the wrapper is still clickable. Bug closed. Screenshots at /app/.screenshots/pill_fix_1100.png and /app/.screenshots/pill_fix_1200.png visually confirm the fix.
rca of the issue: Original root cause (confirmed in iteration_41): a `position: fixed` element using `left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` with `lg:w-auto` gets a containing block width of 50vw (100vw - left), so its shrink-to-fit `w-auto` is capped at 50vw. When the pill's natural content width (~655px) exceeded 50vw (at widths 1024-1200 where 50vw is 512-600px), the pill was clipped to 50vw and the right-most flex child (Get Started CTA) overflowed the visual pill boundary by up to 57.84px. FIX applied in iteration_42: wrap the pill in a full-width `<div class='fixed inset-x-0 top-4 sm:top-6 z-50 flex justify-center px-3 pointer-events-none'>` and make the pill itself `pointer-events-auto ... w-full lg:w-auto max-w-full`. Now the pill's containing block is the full viewport (via the wrapper's flex layout, not translate), so `w-auto` can grow to real content width. Additionally, `pointer-events-none` on the wrapper + `pointer-events-auto` on the pill ensures the transparent 100vw wrapper does not block clicks to hero content behind it. Verified: 9/9 widths PASS with 25px inset, click-through works, no viewport overflow.
